title: Niko Bellic's impossible choice at the end of GTA 4

description:
Deal or Revenge: which ending did you choose? 👇

scenes.text: Niko Bellic's last choice decides who dies at his cousin's wedding.
Mob boss Jimmy Pegorino wants one last heroin deal with Dimitri Rascalov, the man who already betrayed Niko.
Roman says take the money. Kate McReary wants him to walk away from it.
But there is no safe answer. Make the deal, and Dimitri betrays him again. At the wedding, a bullet meant for Niko kills Roman.
Choose revenge, and Pegorino's gunman kills Kate outside the church.
